name: B02 naturally spawned human group observation — prepared disposable save; NOT RUN

steps._note: Final batch only. Prepare a disposable CodexTest world in which an ordinary, unforced world encounter has generated a human group. Do not use spawn/give/setblock to manufacture the group. Record the natural occurrence slot, world-wide persistent leader count, group stable IDs, ownership and saved roles before capture. This JSON only captures loaded entities and errors; it cannot prove the world cap, one-leader rule, persistence or hire protection. Audit those saved/server records manually, then repeat after unload/reload and a second occurrence slot.
